title: Best AI Lead Scoring Tool 2026: Tested Picks & Real-World Reviews
description: HubSpot Breeze AI, 6sense, Salesforce Einstein, MadKudu, and ZoomInfo ranked for 2026: real per-seat pricing, AI model transparency, intent-data coverage, and our verdict on the best AI lead scoring tools for B2B teams.
short_desc: HubSpot Breeze, 6sense, Salesforce Einstein, MadKudu, ZoomInfo ranked - real per-seat pricing, AI scoring transparency, intent-data coverage.
keywords: hubspot breeze ai lead scoring review
tldr_pick: HubSpot Breeze AI Lead Scoring is the best pick for most mid-market B2B teams in 2026 - scoring lives inside the CRM, the free tier is genuinely usable for sub-1,000-contact teams, and Breeze AI trains on your own closed-won/lost history. 6sense is the best pick for enterprise revenue teams that need intent data + AI scoring + ABM in one platform. Salesforce Einstein Lead Scoring is the best pick for Salesforce-centric enterprises with full pipeline forecasting needs. MadKudu is the best pick for B2B SaaS teams that want a focused scoring service to bolt onto HubSpot or Marketo without a full ABM platform spend.
key_takeaways: HubSpot Breeze AI is the best-balanced pick for mid-market B2B - free CRM tier is usable, AI scoring writes directly to the CRM record
6sense is the deepest intent-data + AI scoring platform in 2026, but the $7,200/yr per seat floor blocks smaller teams
Salesforce Einstein Lead Scoring is the most enterprise-trusted option - what your CIO already approves if you run Salesforce
ZoomInfo Lead Scoring at $24,995/yr per seat is the most expensive option on this list and worth skipping for teams under 50 sales reps
who_for: B2B revenue teams of all sizes - SDR managers, marketing ops, RevOps leads, and founders at B2B SaaS companies. The right pick scales by team size: HubSpot for mid-market (under 500 reps), 6sense for enterprise with budget for intent data, Salesforce Einstein for SFDC-centric stacks, MadKudu for focused B2B SaaS scoring, and ZoomInfo only for $25k/seat/year enterprise teams that need the full stack.
methodology: We aggregated 2026 reporting from G2's Lead Scoring category leaderboard (August 2026), HubSpot's AI lead scoring buyer's guide, Salesforce Einstein Lead Scoring documentation, MadKudu's 2026 B2B lead scoring playbook, 6sense's 2026 intent-data report, and Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for ABM platforms. We cross-referenced per-seat pricing and AI feature caps against each vendor's live page. This is an editorial roundup, not a hands-on benchmark - pilot any AI lead scoring tool against your own closed-won/lost history for at least 60 days before trusting AI outputs in production. Pricing verified September 2026.

faq.q: What is the best AI lead scoring tool in 2026?
faq.a: For most mid-market B2B teams, HubSpot Breeze AI Lead Scoring (free CRM, $890/mo Marketing Hub Professional) is the best pick - scoring lives inside the CRM, Breeze AI trains on your own closed deals, and the free CRM tier is genuinely usable. For enterprise teams that need intent data + AI scoring + ABM in one platform, 6sense ($7,200/yr per seat) is the right choice. For Salesforce-centric enterprises, Salesforce Einstein Lead Scoring ($165/user/mo bundled) is the most trusted option.

faq.q: Are free AI lead scoring tools worth using in 2026?
faq.a: HubSpot's free CRM tier ships basic lead scoring with manual rules - useful for teams under 1,000 contacts but limited to rule-based scoring, not AI predictive. If you want AI predictive scoring for free, HubSpot's free tier is the only credible option in 2026. Most other vendors (6sense, MadKudu, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Einstein) require paid plans starting at $890/mo or $7,200/yr per seat.

faq.q: How do you test AI lead scoring tools?
faq.a: Each tool is evaluated on four axes: (1) AI scoring accuracy on your own closed-won/lost history - measure conversion lift over your current rule-based scoring; (2) model transparency - can admins inspect feature weights and override them; (3) data freshness - how often does the score refresh (weekly, daily, real-time); (4) sales handoff - does the scored lead auto-route to the right rep or workflow. We recommend a 60-day pilot against your own pipeline data before committing to annual contracts.

faq.q: How much does AI lead scoring cost in 2026?
faq.a: AI lead scoring ranges from free (HubSpot CRM with manual rules) to $24,995/yr per seat (ZoomInfo Sales + Marketing bundle). Mid-range picks: MadKudu Essentials $1,500/mo, Salesforce Einstein $50-$165/user/mo, 6sense Team $7,200/yr per seat, HubSpot Marketing Hub Professional $890/mo (includes Breeze AI predictive scoring). The floor for usable AI predictive scoring is around $890/mo (HubSpot Pro) or $1,500/mo (MadKudu Essentials).

faq.q: Do AI lead scoring tools work for B2C companies?
faq.a: Most AI lead scoring tools in 2026 are designed for B2B use cases with long sales cycles and account-based selling. The five tools we ranked here are all B2B-focused. For B2C companies, look at predictive CLV tools like Optimove, Pecan, or Vidora instead - they score customers (not leads) and predict lifetime value rather than sales-readiness.

headings.text: Our picks for the best AI lead scoring tools in 2026

products.name: HubSpot AI Lead Scoring (Breeze AI + 2026 Predictive Scoring)
products.pricing: Free CRM with basic lead scoring; Marketing Hub Professional $890/mo (includes Breeze AI predictive scoring); Enterprise $3,600/mo with custom models
products.best_for: Mid-market B2B teams already running HubSpot CRM who want AI scoring that lives inside their existing workflows
products.summary: HubSpot's 2026 lead-scoring stack layers three things on top of the free CRM: Breeze AI predictive scoring (a logistic-regression model trained on your closed-won/lost history), 2026 intent-data enrichment (first-party + Bombora-style feeds), and a no-code scoring-rule builder that lets marketing ops override the AI per-property. G2 ranks HubSpot the leader in Lead Scoring for the second consecutive quarter.
specs: Free CRM: 1,000 contacts, basic lead scoring, manual rules
Marketing Hub Professional: $890/mo - Breeze AI predictive scoring + 5,000 contacts
Marketing Hub Enterprise: $3,600/mo - custom model training + 10,000 contacts
AI scoring refresh: every 24 hours on Standard, every 4 hours on Enterprise
Sales handoff: scored leads auto-route via HubSpot workflows
Integrations: Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho, Microsoft Dynamics, Slack
Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA available on Enterprise
pros: AI scoring lives inside the CRM - no separate platform, no sync delay
Free CRM tier is genuinely usable for teams under 1,000 contacts/month
Breeze AI predictive scoring trains on your own closed deals, not industry averages
cons: Professional tier ($890/mo) is the floor for usable AI scoring - expensive for small teams
Breeze AI scoring is opaque - you cannot inspect feature weights like you can in 6sense

products.name: 6sense Revenue AI for Sales (2026 Edition)
products.pricing: Team $7,200/yr per seat; Enterprise custom pricing (typically $30k-$80k/yr starting); no free tier
products.best_for: Enterprise B2B revenue teams that need intent data + AI predictive scoring + account prioritization in one platform
products.summary: 6sense is the deepest intent-data + predictive-scoring platform in 2026. The AI model ingests Bombora intent surges, first-party site visits, third-party firmographic data, and CRM closed-loop history to produce account-level buying-stage scores plus per-contact predictive scores. The 2026 release added Revenue AI for Sales - an outreach-email copilot grounded in the actual intent signals firing. Gartner ranks 6sense a Leader in the 2026 Magic Quadrant for ABM.
specs: Team: $7,200/yr per seat (annual) - 5 accounts minimum
Enterprise: $30k-$80k/yr starting - 50+ accounts, dedicated CSM
Intent data: Bombora + 6sense proprietary (12+ million B2B topics)
Scoring model refresh: every 4 hours on Enterprise
Buying-stage mapping: 7-stage AI inference (cold to closed-won)
Integrations: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft, Slack, Gong
Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, EU data residency
pros: Deepest intent-data layer in the market - you see accounts 60-90 days before they raise a hand
Buying-stage inference is the most accurate in the category per G2 reviews
Revenue AI for Sales drafts outreach emails grounded in the actual intent signals
cons: No free tier - $7,200/yr per seat is the floor, blocking small teams
6-8 week onboarding - the model needs closed-loop history to be accurate

products.name: Salesforce Einstein Lead Scoring
products.pricing: Included with Salesforce Sales Cloud Einstein ($50/user/mo add-on); Einstein 1 Sales ($165/user/mo) bundles scoring + forecasting + conversation intelligence
products.best_for: Salesforce-centric enterprise teams that want lead scoring native to their CRM with full pipeline forecasting
products.summary: Salesforce Einstein Lead Scoring remains the most enterprise-trusted AI scoring engine in 2026, primarily because it lives inside Salesforce Sales Cloud. The 2026 release added Einstein 1 Sales - a unified bundle combining Lead Scoring, Opportunity Scoring, Account Scoring, Forecasting, and Conversation Intelligence in one $165/user/mo package. The scoring model is fully transparent: admins see feature weights, can override any weight, and can retrain on demand.
specs: Sales Cloud Einstein: $50/user/mo - Lead Scoring + Opportunity Insights
Einstein 1 Sales: $165/user/mo - all of above + Forecasting + Conversation Intelligence
Free trial: 30 days, no credit card required
Scoring model: refreshes nightly, can be retrained on demand
Score range: 1-99 (industry standard) with reason codes
Integrations: native to Salesforce; Slack, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Gmail add-ons
Compliance: SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP Moderate
pros: Most enterprise-trusted scoring engine in 2026 - what your CIO already approves
Transparent model - admins can see and override every feature weight
Bundles with Forecasting + Conversation Intelligence for full revenue intelligence
cons: Requires Salesforce - not a standalone tool
Einstein 1 Sales at $165/user/mo is the most expensive per-seat option on this list

products.name: MadKudu AI Lead Scoring (2026 Predictive Layer)
products.pricing: Essentials $1,500/mo (1,000 scored leads/mo); Growth $3,500/mo (10,000 leads/mo); Enterprise custom pricing
products.best_for: B2B SaaS companies with 1k-50k leads/mo that want a focused scoring service without a full ABM platform
products.summary: MadKudu is the focused lead-scoring specialist in 2026 - it does one thing (predictive lead and account scoring for B2B SaaS) and does it well. The 2026 release shipped MadKudu Signals - a per-account scoring feed that updates every 15 minutes based on product usage, firmographic changes, and engagement events. MadKudu is the best pick for B2B SaaS companies that already have marketing automation (HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot) and need a focused scoring layer to bolt on.
specs: Essentials: $1,500/mo - 1,000 scored leads/mo, weekly model refresh
Growth: $3,500/mo - 10,000 leads/mo, daily model refresh
Enterprise: custom pricing - unlimited leads, real-time scoring
Model refresh cadence: weekly / daily / real-time (by tier)
Output: lead score (1-100), account score (1-100), persona fit, ICP flag
Integrations: Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Segment, Snowflake
Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR
pros: Focused specialist - does one thing (B2B SaaS lead scoring) very well
Cheaper than 6sense - Growth tier ($3,500/mo) covers most mid-market B2B SaaS
MadKudu Signals updates every 15 minutes for real-time scoring
cons: B2B SaaS only - not a fit for B2C or B2B2C use cases
No intent-data layer of its own - you still need Bombora or G2 Buyer Intent if you want that

products.name: ZoomInfo Lead Scoring (formerly DiscoverOrg + 2026 Copilot)

The 2026 release added Copilot Studio for tuning the AI's outreach voice per team. Right pick for $25k/seat/year enterprise stacks.
